Definition: Chur, the name of four Israelites and one Midianite
BiblicalUsage: Hur is the name of several men, and the two clearest are the one who goes up the hill with Moses while Joshua fights Amalek below and the king of Midian killed in the war with the Midianites. Aaron and Hur stand with Moses on the hill, and the other Hur dies with the kings of Midian. The name is the same, and the men are not.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hur shows how one name can hold two very different stories: a man who stands with Moses on the hill, and a king who falls in judgment. The first Hur is the one I want to be like.
